title: Pricing exemptions playbook: audit trail and delegated approvals
creator: Evelyn Grant
description: Problem: Sales and CS frequently request one-off pricebook exceptions for enterprise contracts. Today approvals are ad-hoc (email + spreadsheets), causing slow turnaround, inconsistent justifications, and no machine-readable audit trail. Goal: Create a single playbook and lightweight workflow that (1) defines delegation thresholds, exception lifetime and renewal rules, and required justification fields; (2) implements an auditable approval chain with immutable records; (3) automates common updates to the pricebook and notifies downstream systems (billing, console). Scope: enterprise one-off discounts, temporary credits, and listed SOW line-item pricing. Not in scope: subscription platform pricing model changes and partner/channel rebate programs.
acceptance_criteria: Delegation matrix documented and signed-off by Finance and Legal
Approval workflow implemented in Salesforce + webhook to pricebook service with immutable audit ID
Pricebook update automation (PR + audit stamp) ready in sandbox and tested end-to-end
UI/email notifications for approvers and requester with SLA counters configured
Monthly audit report generation and a dashboard tile in Console summarizing exceptional pricing activity
